review_method: Local static evidence reads and five actual original-image openings with tools.view_image. No execution, hash calculation, image processing or validation was performed.

module_snapshot.identity_policy: All SHA values are owner declarations. Remaining exact paths, sizes, source mappings and execution-input identities refer to this immutable input and module inventory. The supplied input's own SHA declaration is pending; no local rehash is claimed.

references.comparison_status: Related logical contract only; no independent exact-state reference exists for the four supplemental cases.
references.viewing_record: Opened the assigned original directly. tools.view_image returned high detail and displayed it at 1368 x 1824; the original physical dimensions and factor-two reference scale remain unchanged. No worker crop or resize was generated.
references.observation: The reference provides the right-anchored outlined sheet, serif heading, two-column sort grid, inverse selected cell and full-width Done control. It selects recent-read and has no direction/filter rows, so neither its selected state nor sheet height is an exact oracle for these supplemental captures.

shared_actual_observation: All four native 930 x 1240 candidates show eight readable sort cells, two direction controls, four filter controls and Done inside a continuous outlined sheet. The serif heading, clear sans-serif labels, aligned cell borders and white text on selected black cells remain legible. Header and sort-grid placement follow the related reference; the added direction/filter controls extend the sheet downward within the viewport. No visible control label is clipped. Exposed library rows, page 1/3 and bottom navigation remain readable.

shared_contract_checks.direction: Old-to-new is visibly selected in all four candidates. Each existing action file requests sort, ascending direction, then filter-menu; each currentState reports the matching library_sort and library_ascending=true. The existing case record's persistence check records the same saved sort and ascending value. These are existing static evidence observations, not new Store queries or execution.
shared_contract_checks.HANDOFF166: The accepted direction-label contract applies to latest-chapter and numeric count sorts. The labels are not a new actionable suggestion.
shared_contract_checks.Store_and_visibility: Existing case records contain currentState unread values and a Store Book agreement record. Only exposed PNG badges are directly visible; badges and titles covered by the sheet are not visually accepted from state fields.
shared_contract_checks.capability: This batch qualifies visible desktop capture behavior only; it does not qualify physical input, hidden hit regions, hardware rotation, e-ink effects or cold-start behavior.

limitations: These supplemental captures have only the assigned related reference. Missing exact-state references are unavailable, not passed.

Overlay-covered library titles and badges have no direct pixel verdict. Differences in real counts, titles and covers do not waive exposed text legibility or geometry.
